products.title: Lenovo ThinkVision T24-40 LED monitor
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkVision T24-40 is a 24-inch LED-backlit IPS monitor designed for productivity and creativity. It features a Full HD (1920 x 1080) resolution with a 120 Hz refresh rate and 250 cd/m² brightness. The monitor is finished in eclipse black and includes a versatile stand allowing for height, pivot, swivel, and tilt adjustments. Connectivity options include HDMI, VGA, DisplayPort, and a USB 3.2 Gen 1 hub with USB-C power delivery up to 15W. It also incorporates Natural Low Blue Light technology and is Eyesafe Certified 2.0 to reduce eye strain.

Connectivity options include VGA and HDMI ports, and the monitor comes with an adjustable tilt stand and VESA compatibility.

products.title: ThinkVision 24" FHD IPS Monitor
products.description: The Lenovo ThinkVision S24-4e is a 24-inch flat IPS monitor featuring a 16:9 aspect ratio and Full HD (1920 × 1080) resolution. With a 100 Hz refresh rate and a 4 ms response time, it delivers smooth visuals and wide 178° viewing angles. The monitor boasts a contrast ratio of 1300:1, a brightness of 250 nits, and 99% sRGB color gamut for accurate image reproduction. Its anti-glare screen and flicker-free technology ensure comfortable viewing. Connectivity options include 1 HDMI and 1 VGA port. This bundle also includes a Dockztorm USB Hub for high-speed data transfer up to 5 Gbps. The monitor is VESA mountable and features adjustable tilt from -5° to +22°.

products.title: 27 inch Monitor
products.description: This 27-inch ThinkVision T27QD-4v monitor is designed for seamless online collaboration. It features a QHD resolution, a 48-120Hz variable refresh rate, and 99% sRGB/BT.709 color coverage for sharp, color-accurate visuals. Equipped with a 5MP webcam, noise-canceling microphones, and 5W stereo speakers, it offers a full VoIP solution. The monitor includes a one-cable docking solution with up to 100W power delivery, data, and internet connectivity. Additional features include Windows Hello quick login, AI-powered collaboration tools, and Natural Low Blue Light technology for eye comfort. The LTPS stand allows for flexible ergonomic adjustments, and an integrated smart sensor enhances user experience by providing proximity alerts, movement reminders, and auto-screen off functionality. It also supports daisy-chaining for expanded screen real estate and modular Lenovo Tiny PC mounting.
